slit_topology_requirements: lower and upper crack faces must be selected using distinct adjacent face centroids
lower edge set and upper edge set must be nonempty and contain distinct geometry edges
mesh node sets for lower and upper crack faces must be disjoint except at the notch tip vertex
coincident node pairs must exist along the crack line
zero bridge elements may span lower and upper crack faces
open slit topology must be preserved from x=-0.5 to notch tip
